description: This Kotlin source file defines the SkipRatingActivity class, which serves as a fallback activity to route the user back to PlaybackActivity when rating is skipped.

classes.name: SkipRatingActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that immediately routes the user back to PlaybackActivity, passing along a content ID as an extra.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the Activity's onCreate method to initialize the activity, retrieve the content ID from intent extras, and start the PlaybackActivity.
